create_matrix_game_rps: create a perturbed rock-paper-scissors matrix game using pyspiel.create_matrix_game with payoff matrices
run_mmd_dilated_qre: run MMD with dilated entropy to solve for quantal response equilibrium in a matrix game
build_mmd_solver: build an MMDDilatedEnt solver instance with a pyspiel game and alpha regularization parameter
test_mmd_convergence: test MMD solver convergence by calling update_sequences and get_gap over multiple iterations
summarize_mmd_policies: summarize MMD solver results by extracting action probability policies and current sequences
